source_caption:
When shooting Black Swan, Natalie Portman sustained many injuries that caused frequent production delays. Her left toe was injured so often that it had to be restrapped while the cast and crew waited, leading the crew to joke about a “Natalie Portman’s Left Toe Delay,” which was later cleverly shortened to Portmantoe. 

To fully commit to the role and look like a convincing ballerina, Portman lost 20 pounds. Her dedication went even further: she began intensive ballet training before she had even received an official script, running entirely on pure faith that the film would actually be made. 
-
 🎥: Black Swan(2010)
 Dir: Darren Aronofsky

source_details.title: Black Swan
source_details.synopsis: Black Swan is a 2010 American psychological horror thriller film directed by Darren Aronofsky, from a screenplay by Mark Heyman, John McLaughlin, and Andres Heinz, and based on a story by Heinz. Starring Natalie Portman, Vincent Cassel, Mila Kunis, Barbara Hershey, and Winona Ryder, the film follows a production of Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake by the company of New York City Ballet, led by Artistic Director Thomas Leroy (Cassel). The production requires a ballerina to play the innocent and fragile White Swan, for which the committed dancer Nina Sayers (Portman) is a perfect fit, as well as the dark and sensual Black Swan, which are qualities better embodied by the new rival Lily (Kunis).
